# fabric_org_apps (Data Source)

The Org Apps data-source allows you to retrieve a list of Fabric [Org Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/fabric/orgapp/items/create-org-app).

-> This data-source supports Service Principal authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get all items in workspace
data "fabric_org_apps" "example" {
  workspace_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) The Workspace ID.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `values` (Attributes Set) The set of Org Apps. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--values))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>

### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

<a id="nestedatt--values"></a>

### Nested Schema for `values`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) The Org App description.
- `display_name` (String) The Org App display name.
- `folder_id` (String) The Org App Folder ID.
- `id` (String) The Org App ID.
- `properties` (Attributes) The Org App properties. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--values--properties))
- `tags` (Set of String) A set of tag IDs assigned to the Org App.
- `workspace_id` (String) The Workspace ID.

<a id="nestedatt--values--properties"></a>

### Nested Schema for `values.properties`

Read-Only:

- `onelake_root_path` (String) OneLake path to the Org App root directory.
